artifacts.summary: Implementation plan with 2 phases to fill 3 sorry markers in GNBA.lean completeness counter cycling using inline unfold-and-split strategy

memory_candidates.content: In large Lean 4 files (1400+ lines), lean_goal and lean_hover_info may timeout. Use lake build for verification and lean_run_code with minimal reproductions for tactic testing. For Nat.rec-based definitions, simp only [..., Nat.rec_add_one] unfolds the recursion, after which split handles nested dite/ite chains. This pattern reliably resolves goals involving recursive counter definitions in omega-automata proofs.
